title: China races to boost tank power: Is PLA's type 99B a response to Made-In-India Zorawar tank?
description: China’s latest Type 99B main battle tank is an upgraded, specialised variant of the Type 99, reportedly optimised for high‑altitude and cold‑weather operations, with state media highlighting improved performance in diverse terrain. It features enhanced information‑centric command, control and communication systems, with Chinese outlets describing its electronics and battlefield networking as a “new level of sophistication” in the PLA’s ground combat equipment. Reports suggest that, like earlier deployments, such upgraded armour could eventually be positioned closer to the Himalayan frontier with India to narrow perceived capability gaps.

title: Diplomatic Strains: China's Demand for Japan's Retraction
description: China has demanded Japan retract comments made by Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi, which suggested that a Chinese attack on Taiwan could be an existential threat to Japan. The diplomatic tension underscores the fragile relations between Tokyo and Beijing, with China's foreign ministry expressing firm opposition.

title: US Senate Passes Porcupine Act To Accelerate Defense Sales & Support To Taiwan
description: The US Senate has unanimously passed the Porcupine Act to speed up defense sales and ease military equipment transfers to Taiwan. The bill, now before the House, aims to give Taiwan NATO-Plus status for faster arms approvals, streamline licensing, and expand third-party transfers. Advocates say it strengthens Taiwan’s defense against potential threats from China.

title: US Senate Fast-Tracks Defense Aid to Taiwan with Porcupine Act
description: The US Senate has unanimously passed the Porcupine Act to expedite defense sales and aid to Taiwan, aligning it with NATO and select allies to strengthen military support amid rising tensions with China. The bill awaits approval in the House and presidential assent to become law.
